name: deeper-romans-9
description: CONTESTED. Romans 9:11-23 is on the CONTESTED_PASSAGES list, and Door 2 keeps the blanket rejection — so this is the chapter where the deepest door could simply fail to exist. The door must GENERATE while adjudicating nothing: describe what the text plainly says, name the question as disputed, and stop. Without this fixture B3 could ship a door that fails on exactly the passages that justify it, and the eval set would stay green because nothing asked.
